Made with care

01

Private by design

No analytics, no ads, no third parties. Passwords and data are generated and processed on your device with the Web Crypto API.

02

Fast & offline

Pages are tiny and cached on first visit, so most tools keep working on a plane, in a basement, or behind a firewall.

03

Free, quietly

No sign-ups, no paywalls, no pop-ups. Press CtrlK anywhere to jump straight to a tool.
